claims.text: Format: the young adult is usually seen alone, sometimes with a parent, guardian, partner, spouse or friend; HEEADSSS or SSHADESS can organize the questions.
claims.quote: In most cases, the young adult will be alone at the visit. In some situations, especially if the young adult has a special health care need, he may be accompanied by a parent, guardian, partner, spouse, or friend. Some clinicians use the HEEADSSS or SSHADESS mnemonics to help organize the questions for their young adult patients.
claims.locator: 18 through 21 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Ask the young adult: health since the last visit and any medical questions, problems or concerns; how things are going with family, friends, job and school; future plans for employment, education or relationships.
claims.quote: Have you been in good health since your last visit here? Do you have any medical questions, problems, or concerns? What questions or worries do you have that you want to cover today? • How are things going with your family, your friends, your job, in school? • What are your future plans for employment, further education, or relationships?
claims.locator: 18 through 21 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Past medical hx: any specialty or emergency care since the last visit.
claims.quote: received any specialty or emergency care since the last visit?
claims.locator: 18 through 21 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Family hx: any new health condition or death in the family; if yes, who has or had it, age at onset and diagnosis, or age at death.
claims.quote: developed a new health condition or died? If the answer is Yes: Ascertain who in the family has or had the condition, and ask about the age of onset and diagnosis. If they are no longer living, ask about their age at the time of death.
claims.locator: 18 through 21 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: ROS — any problems with: frequent headaches or dizziness; fainting; eyes or vision; ears or hearing; nose or throat; breathing problems or chest pain; belly pain, vomiting, bowel problems; painful urination or other urine problems; rashes, moles, sunburn; muscle aches, injury or other problems; fatigue. Young women: last period; problems with periods; vaginal itching, burning or discharge.
claims.quote: Do you have any problems with • Regular or frequent headaches or dizziness • Fainting or passing out • Eyes or vision • Ears or hearing • Nose or throat • Breathing problems or chest pains • Belly aches or pains, throwing up, problems with bowel movements • Painful urination or other urine problems • Rashes, moles, sunburn • Muscle aches, injury, or other problems • Fatigue For Young Women • When was your last period? • Do you have any problems with your periods? • Do you have any itching, burning, or discharge in your vaginal area?
claims.locator: 18 through 21 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems
